title: `notifications/resources/list_changed`
description: The notification a server sends when the set of available resources changes.
question: Does the framework notice when the resource list changes?
why: Resource sets change far more often than tool sets, because they track real files and records. A stale list means the agent offers context that no longer exists.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers publishing this. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: at 2026-07-28 a change arrives only on a `subscriptions/listen` stream, and `MCPServerStdio` never opens one, so its `message_handler` heard nothing. The next ``list_resources`` still asks the server (the default `cache_tools_list=False` for tools), so the agent sees the change on its next list, not when the server announced it.
notes.pydantic-ai: Pydantic AI 2.54.0: `MCPToolset` caches ``list_resources`` and clears the cache only when a list_changed notification arrives. At 2026-07-28 that notification travels only on a `subscriptions/listen` stream, which the toolset never opens, so the cache was never cleared and the next list was stale for the rest of the session.
notes.strands: Strands Agents 1.59.0: `on_tools_changed` is the only change hook, and it covers tools only. Nothing hears the resources notification, but `list_resources_sync` asks the server every time, so the next listing shows the change.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): MCPClient opens no `subscriptions/listen` stream and registers no notification handler, so the change is never heard. `listResources()` fetches on every call, so the next list shows the added resource.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0 at 2026-07-28: the change is published on `subscriptions/listen`, which the SDK never opens; it shows only because the next `listResources` asks the server again.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` lists and calls tools only; it has no resource or prompt API, so a resources list_changed notification has nothing to refresh, and no hook hears it.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy's MCP support is `dspy.Tool.from_mcp_tool`, which converts one tool. It has no resource or prompt API, so resources and prompts stay on the caller's MCP session. No listing means no change to see.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): a `ResourceListChangedHandler` on the caller's `*mcp.Client` hears the notification, but mcptoolset lists only tools, so the agent has no resources list to refresh.
notes.ms_agent_framework_dotnet: Microsoft Agent Framework (.NET) 1.24.0 (ModelContextProtocol 2.2.0): a handler registered in `McpClientOptions.Handlers.NotificationHandlers` for `notifications/resources/list_changed` heard nothing, because the server publishes the change on `subscriptions/listen`, which the client never opens. The next list request refetches and shows the change.
